$comment: Single source of truth for the aggregator (what to write) and validate-profile.mjs (what to check). requiredSections are matched case-insensitively as the start of a markdown heading. items are guidance for the aggregator; 'from' names the researcher whose findings file supplies it.

items.item: Channel line: name, URL, presenter, subscriber count and analysis date
Per-video table: id, title, date, length, views, cuts, median shot, mean, cuts in first 60s, shots >10s, look. Pacing columns copied verbatim from research/pacing.json
What tracks views: topic type vs pacing vs look, stated as evidence not hunches; never claim a correlation the table does not show
Era timeline if the look changed over time (era, videos, presenter, look, median shot)
Opening beat tables for at least 3 videos: Time | Spoken idea | Visual change | Sound cue | Viewer question | Payoff
Body shapes (one per video type) and ending patterns
Transferable mechanisms: the how, not the content
What would distract (don't copy), including identity, branding and verbatim lines
Not assessed: blind spots and sampling limits (frame spacing, transcript quality, audio)
Style prompt: one paragraph a designer could build from
Colour roles with hex, each with a meaning; matches tokens.css exactly
Typography: display/body/serif/mono with the closest Google Font and where each is used; caption rules
Motion: entrances, exits, transitions, easing feel; pacing quoted only from the analysis.md table
Card kinds observed, with built vs not yet built
Legacy variants / eras, opt-in per video
What NOT to do
Persona: who speaks, to whom, tone, on/off camera, register
Language rules: language mix, terms kept in which language, signature connectors (paraphrased patterns), units, sentence length, words per minute
Hook formulas, one per observed opening, each tagged with its source video
Body structure per video type
Endings and calls to action, by era
On-screen text rules (what gets captioned, emphasis)
Timed script template
Not assessed: delivery, tone of voice, transcript accuracy
Base colours sampled from frames, with a comment naming the role
Optional legacy/era colours, clearly marked opt-in
Fonts, type scale, easings and durations
Blueprint fields filled; palette hex identical to tokens.css
inspiration + summary mention the creator, video count and date range
variants array if there are eras
cards: only cards that exist on disk; leave [] if none built yet
